defs.def: the general position a person or thing moves or points towards 方向；方位

ex.s: When I applied to graduate school, I found three programmes promising to allow me to follow my desired research direction.
ex.t: 当我申请研究生院时，我发现有三个项目承诺允许我按照自己期望的研究方向发展。

ex.s: This ability to recognize that a shape will need to be turned in a specific direction before it will fit is called an “allocentric frame of reference”.
ex.t: 这种识别形状需要朝特定方向旋转才能放入的能力被称为"异中心参照系"。

ex.s: It helped sharpen her sense of direction.
ex.t: 帮助提高了她的方向感。

ex.s: As they came in my direction, I put on my brightest and happiest smile.
ex.t: 当他们朝我走来时，我露出最灿烂最开心的笑容。

ex.s: Dad did the driving but he has a poor sense of direction.
ex.t: 爸爸负责开车，但他的方向感很差。

ex.s: The bumps and rocks that lined the road under the basket caused the ball to bounce in all directions.
ex.t: 沿路排列在篮筐下的颠簸和岩石使球向各个方向弹跳。

ex.s: As they gathered in the public square, one of them, the chicken, was seen by her neighbours going in the opposite direction.
ex.t: 当它们聚集在公共广场上时，其中一个——小鸡——被她的邻居看到朝相反的方向走去。

ex.s: On each floor, hallways stretched in four directions, leading to classrooms, laboratories, and teachers’ offices.
ex.t: 每层楼的走廊向四个方向延伸，通向教室、实验室和教师办公室。

ex.s: Having a poor sense of direction, Eva found it impossible to get around in such a huge building.
ex.t: 由于方向感很差，伊娃发现在这样一座巨大的建筑里根本无法走动。

ex.s: Emotional intelligence, with its focus or both head and heart, may serve to point us in the right direction.
ex.t: 情商兼顾头脑与内心，或许能为我们指明正确的方向。

ex.s: Giving directions.
ex.t: 指路。

ex.s: 36  Here’s a handful of ways that will set you in the right direction.
ex.t: 36 这里有几个方法能让你走上正确的方向。

ex.s: Still, don't go too far in the other direction.
ex.t: 不过，也不要过分走向另一个极端。

ex.s: People with more consistent stories tend to have a stronger sense of identity, and they feel their life has more meaning, direction and sense of purpose.
ex.t: 那些拥有更连贯人生故事的人往往有更强的身份认同感，并且觉得他们的生活更有意义、更有方向感和目标感。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

defs.def: the general way in which a person or thing develops 趋势；动向
the general position a person or thing comes or develops from 方面
a purpose; an aim 目的；目标

ex.s: When someone is giving you directions, try to mark your destinations and draw the routes to them on the map.
ex.t: 当有人给你指路时，试着在地图上标出你的目的地并画出到达它们的路线。

defs.def: instructions about how to do sth, where to go, etc. 用法说明；操作指南；旅行指南

ex.s: Give directions and be prepared to provide further information about your town.
ex.t: 给人指路，并准备好提供更多关于你所在城镇的信息。

ex.s: She put the new color on her hair or sat still for 30 minutes, just as the directions saying.
ex.t: 她把染发剂涂在头发上，然后静坐了30分钟，就像说明书上写的那样。

ex.s: Directions: In Section A, you will hear ten short conversations between two speakers.
ex.t: 说明：在A部分，你将听到两段说话者之间的十段简短对话。

ex.s: Directions: In Section B you will hear two short passages, and one longer conversation ,after each passage.
ex.t: 说明：在B部分，你将听到两篇短文和一段较长的对话，每篇短文之后都有相应的问题。

ex.s: Directions: After reading the passages below, fill in the blanks to make the passages coherent and grammatically correct.
ex.t: 说明：阅读下面短文后，填空使短文连贯。

ex.s: Directions: Fill in each blank with a proper word chosen from the box.
ex.t: 说明：从方框中选出合适的词填入每个空白处。

ex.s: Directions: For each blank in the following passage there are four words or phrases marked A, B, C and D.
ex.t: 说明：在下面短文中的每个空白处，都有标为A、B、C、D的四个单词或短语。

ex.s: Directions: Read the following three passages.
ex.t: Directions: 阅读以下三篇短文。

ex.s: Directions: Read the following passage.
ex.t: Directions: 阅读以下短文。

ex.s: Directions: Translate the following sentences into English，using the words given in the brackets.
ex.t: 说明：将下列句子翻译成英语，使用括号中给出的单词。

ex.s: Directions: Write an English composition in 120-150 words according to the instructions given below in Chinese.
ex.t: 说明：根据以下中文提示写一篇120-150词的英语作文。

defs.def: the art of managing or guiding sb/sth 管理；指导
the instructions given by sb directing a film/movie （电影导演的）指点，指示
